run_populate_data_conf_primary: run the script to populate train_primary.yaml config from primary training data directories
run_populate_data_conf_mined: run the script to populate train_mined.yaml config from mined bitext data
run_populate_data_conf_bt: run the script to populate train_bt.yaml config from backtranslated data
get_bt_datasets: discover backtranslated datasets in direction directories and return Dataset objects with src and tgt paths
get_primary_datasets: discover primary training datasets across multiple paths and return Dataset objects with src and tgt
